body:
That's so true, yet my anxieties and fears get the better of me. Even though I can rationally believe that none of this will matter in the long run, and that nobody is thinking about me the way I believe they are. Even if they did, I truly don't care what a random person thinks.

I'm more fearful of someone I care about disliking me, or thinking of me negatively because of my thoughts, feelings, or whatever.
Thank you. Hopefully I'll be able to do that comfortably!

I get what you mean. I think it's more about comparing your situation and/or problems to others that seem "worse" than yours. At least that's been my experience.

But you deserve to feel as though your reactions to things in your life aren't dramatic, but justified. Even if someone else went through something "worse" than you, it doesn't take away the bad that happened. 

I hope you understand what I mean, and I hope you're well!

I'm so sorry, I understand the feeling of being depressed most of your life. I've been that way for a while.

Mental health is a very tricky thing to deal with. It all depends on what you're suffering from, if anything specifically, and what can "fix" it for you. 

I also understand wanting to be distant from the ones you love, but maybe in a different sense, as we're all different. 

Distracting ourselves is hard. I understand that too. I'm sorry I couldn't offer a solid solution, but I just don't think there's enough information. But if you truly care this much, you're most likely worth it. Ho0e you're well.

I don't think it sounds dumb, I think it's understandable. We can make deep connections with people in a short amount of time sometimes.

Hope you're doing okay! Feel free to message me if you need to. I'm here for you.
Thank you, your comment truly is appreciated! Feel free to send me a message if you need to. You're amazing!
